prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Houston. I'd just pulled into a row looking for an open space near the entrance.

Q: What were you driving, and how fast were you going?

A: A midsize sedan. I was moving slowly, maybe walking speed, because the lot was crowded and people were backing out everywhere.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not at first. A silver SUV came out from between two parked trucks on my right. I hit my brakes, but there wasn't much room, and we made contact on my front passenger side.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injury right away, or did symptoms develop later?

A: I felt a jolt through my right shoulder and my neck, but I figured it was just the seatbelt. By that evening the shoulder was really sore and I couldn't lift my arm above my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the next day, and they referred me to an orthopedic doctor. I've had physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?

A: Just that I'm still having trouble sleeping on my right side, and I'd like to know what happens next with the claim.

Q: Understood. I'll note that and follow up with you about next steps. Thank you for your time.

A: Thank you.
